wire.source: existing pathLocale(location.pathname), after existing consent checks
wire.server: retain exact strings from allowlist; drop invalid values, no Accept-Language/IP/URL inference

population: all existing observed product sessions in [start,end), with existing placeholder/event exclusions
selection: locale of first received product event ordered by server created_at then DB id; no PAGE_VIEW required
unknown: first event missing/invalid/unsupported -> unknown permanently within this window, no later backfill
switching: later page languages do not move or split a session; current language is still attached to each new event

engagement.numerator: distinct cohort sessions with matching received event anywhere in the window

empty: rows=[]; no_data UI, never fabricated language groups
compatibility: optional UsageReport.locale_cohorts; old clients without locale -> unknown; old API drops new metadata; legacy report without block still renders
rollout: API before web if a deployment is later authorized; no deployment in this execution
